scientific_integrity: The claimed uniqueness follows from the strict convexity proof, not finite optimizer sampling. Closest published spectral-gap result on the identical graph is explicitly acknowledged, with no claim of originality for that spectral-gap calculation.
scientific_limitations: Two-price complete split graphs with premium clique edges only; finite observation horizon and ordinary symmetric Laplacian.
No formula asserted for heterogeneous edge prices, nonuniform vertex masses, or the full cheaper-than-unit price phase diagram.
Standalone finite computations are supplemental; universal claims rely on the analytic strict-convexity and spectral proof.
Unindexed equivalent results remain an originality risk; independent audit not performed.
title: Reentrant finite-horizon investment in premium clique edges of complete split networks
